messages:
rachel: dev-bot flagged a steady error-rate rise on embeddings-serving after the 5.0.0 rollout. Autorollback scheduled in 9m. tagging ops for hold/veto. https://internal.redwood/telemetry/3198765432

dev-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-serving error-rate +1.9% -> +6.7%. Suggested: PARTIAL ROLLBACK route:embeddings -> v4.9.2 in 9m unless overridden. Probable: model sharding change.

martin: oncall here. want to run quick grouping & smoke before rollback. request 5m hold to confirm it's route-specific.

ops-oncall: +1 to 5m hold. last time we rolled back without route pin we caused cache churn. run `sentry query` and a 20-request probe.

priyanka: running grouping: `sentry query \"service:embeddings error\" timeframe:5m`. initial group shows `InvalidHeader` spikes tied to shard handshake.

rachel: ok hold. plan: probe at +1m and +3m. if errors persist >5% we'll do targeted route pin. priyanka can you prepare rollback snippet?

priyanka: rollback snippet:
```
infra pin-route --route embeddings --version 4.9.2
infra traffic-slice --route embeddings --from 5%->100% --window 20s
infra monitor --route embeddings --check errors,p95 --duration 5m
```

ops-oncall: probe1 results -> error-rate 6.1%, probe2 -> 6.9%. this is persistent. recommending manual partial rollback now.

martin: executing pin-route now.

ops-oncall: pin-route complete; traffic-slice started (5%->100%).

dev-bot: ACTION: autorollback canceled by operator; partial rollback executed for embeddings route to v4.9.2.

priyanka: monitoring 5m: errors down to 0.5%, p95 normal. filing INF-5077: sharding handshake bug for 5.0.0.

comms: drafting internal note. holding customer-facing note until eng-runtime triages. rachel: please add a release-notes flag to freeze public blurb.

rachel: added freeze. closing thread: manual partial rollback executed, autorollback canceled. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
